text.config.interactic.title: Interactic Configuration
text.config.interactic.option.clientOnly: Only the visual features. Use this on servers that don't have Interactic installed.
text.config.interactic.option.rightClick: Pick up items by right-clicking them (also enables the pickup keybind).
text.config.interactic.option.itemThrowi: Hold the drop key to charge up and throw items farther.
text.config.interactic.option.itemFilter: Adds the Item Filter, which controls what you auto-pickup.
text.config.interactic.option.itemsActAs: Thrown weapons and tools deal damage when they hit something.
text.config.interactic.option.autoPickup: Pick up items by walking over them like vanilla.
text.config.interactic.option.fancyItemR: Dropped items lie on the ground and tumble when thrown.
text.config.interactic.option.renderItem: Show the name of the item under your crosshair.
text.config.interactic.option.renderFull: Show the full tooltip of the item under your crosshair.
text.config.interactic.option.swingArm.t: Swing your arm when dropping items.
text.config.interactic.option.blocksLayF: Dropped blocks lie flat on the ground too.
